text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The annual Summer Training Camp has begun! 
At the lodging house, Kitasan Black 
strikes up a conversation with Satono 
Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black shared what she thought the 
fans expected of her. She declared that 
she would show them she never gives up 
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond smiles, saying that's just 
like Kitasan Black. The two of them 
encourage each other to keep doing their 
best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the training camp, Satono 
Diamond had a request regarding her 
training. She said she wanted to increase 
the power in her stride.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To challenge Mejiro McQueen in peak 
condition, and keeping future 
international races in mind, the Trainer 
decided to grant her wish.
